name: Lois (Timothy's grandmother)
title: The Faithful Grandmother
summary: Lois was the grandmother of Timothy and the mother of Eunice. She is known for her sincere faith, which she passed on to her daughter and grandson, and she played a vital role in establishing the Christian faith in her family before Paul arrived in Lystra.

keyEvents.title: Her Sincere Faith
keyEvents.description: Paul recalls the sincere faith that first lived in Lois, then in her daughter Eunice, and finally in Timothy. This faith was the foundation of Timothy's ministry.

keyEvents.title: The Legacy of Faith Through Generations
keyEvents.description: Lois represents the important role grandparents play in passing faith to future generations. Her faithfulness resulted in Timothy becoming one of Paul's most trusted coworkers.

keyEvents.title: Training in the Scriptures
keyEvents.description: Together with Eunice, Lois ensured that Timothy was familiar with the holy scriptures from childhood, which could make him wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
